sources.snippet: The achieved CORE score of this base model is 0.3382. (For comparison, d32 is 0.3168, d20 "speedrun" is 0.22, GPT-2 is 0.25). This upload allows you to skip base model pretraining and focus on finetuning, which is a lot cheaper, and saves you $2,500 of cost.
